messages:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout v2026.4 -> us-west-2 (10% traffic). Canaries: 50 req/s target. RunID: dpl-1791234567

anne: seeing spike in 500s for /generate from canary, started ~09:12 UTC. Error rate ~4% now :eyes:

incident-bot: ALERT: increased 5xx rate in us-west-2 (service: inference-api). p95 latency 980ms, baseline 120ms. Incident created: INC-2026-113

mohit: pausing the rollout. @deploy-bot can you hold or abort the canary? We need to triage.

deploy-bot: Actions available: `pause`, `abort`, `rollforward`, `rollback --to v2026.3`.

jamie: don't rollforward. Abort and rollback to v2026.3 if abort fails. Also pin traffic to v2026.3 until postmortem. We need an owner for customer comms.

lucas: I'll take rollback. If abort is clean we can re-route traffic. If not, run `kubectl rollback` plan ready. Recommend 100% revert to v2026.3 and stop further deploys for next change window.

sara: suspicion it's DB throttle from recent index change. @mohit can ops check DB tail for slow queries matching canary traffic timeframe? :mag:

mohit: on it. Querying logs now. If DB is saturated, rollback won't fix gold path; but it will reduce load from canary.

deploy-bot: Received `abort` command (user: jamie). Aborting rollout... Abort succeeded. Canary containers terminated. :white_check_mark:

anne: error rate trending down after abort, p95 back to ~150ms. Good sign.

lucas: proceeding with rollback to v2026.3 to be safe. Rolling back... RunID: rbk-1791234567

deploy-bot: Rollback to v2026.3 started. Routing change step 1/3: 50% -> 100% over 5 minutes. Command: ```/deploy rollback --to v2026.3 --step 50 --wait 300``` 

incident-bot: NOTE: tied incident INC-2026-113 to this thread. Severity: SEV2. Assigned: mohit, lucas.

mohit: DB tail shows spike in write latency coincident with canary start; opening DB ticket and reverting index change in staging. Will update.

jamie: decisions: 1) freeze releases for the rest of day, 2) pin traffic to v2026.3 (sha: abc123def), 3) reschedule v2026.4 to next change window Mon 10:00 UTC pending postmortem and load test. Everyone ok?

sara: +1. I'll update release notes: mark v2026.4 postponed and add rollback note.

anne: +1. Add a short blurb to status page: degraded -> resolved, then note rollback to v2026.3.

lucas: rollback completed. All services at v2026.3. Verifying metrics.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. New cluster state: v2026.3 (stable). :lock:

anne: metrics look normal. p95 130ms, error rate <0.1% again. Closing hold.

jamie: opening follow-up doc for postmortem and schedule blameless review at 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC. Assigning to mohit + lucas. I'll own customer comms draft.

mohit: noted. I'll include DB findings.

sara: Updating release tracker and PRs. Will re-run canary in staging after DB fix.

jamie: thanks all. Reopen if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
